topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the administrative welcome, course context, and foundational learning objectives for the lecture series.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of differentiation, genetic regulation, and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological basis of cancer as a progressive failure of cellular differentiation, genetic control, and three-dimensional tissue organization.

topics.label: Pathology and progression of tumor invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the histological hallmarks, mechanisms, and stepwise progression that distinguish benign neoplasms from invasive and metastatic malignancies.

topics.label: Neoplasm nomenclature and mechanisms of clinical morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the classification and naming conventions of tumors alongside the physiological mechanisms by which neoplasms cause disease and death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence and comparative oncology across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the epidemiological distribution and patterns of neoplasia across human populations and diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical symptoms and cancer screening strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address clinical tumor presentation and the diagnostic utility of population screening across various organ systems.

topics.label: Lecture closing and housekeeping
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a review of learning outcomes and reminders for upcoming practical sessions.
